note: Both sets are essentially identical in content and share the same defects: the Living Room finished floor value 2' - 3 1/2" is not in the text layer (both sections read 2' - 9 1/2"), and 'Mechanical Room | location | Building Section A302' mislabels the sheet number A-302 as a building section. The only differences are naming precision on the scale claims: B binds the scales to 'Living Room Section (A1)' and 'Section - Centre Module (C1)', while A uses the looser 'Section C1' and 'Living Room Section'. Both also carry the same vague/duplicative claims (repeated finished-floor and grade-level elevations, 'building section | contains room', tautological 'WEST MODULE | location | West').
